criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 2 and 4 finished, 6 holds its scale. 7's slabs at 1.55 to 1 on a beige band; mannequin officer on 5 and 6; stock folders on 8; 9's oversized notice and riser notch.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one parcel, two working devices; 7's canvas mean 54.0 against 22.8 to 35.7 jumps the value track.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Slide 2's headline and the title adopt the city's 'concern, not a violation' framing while FOX 4 reports the memo's 3,700 violations; slide 3's headline is the city's self-description unattributed; slide 8's December without its year.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where land; the stake is general and the story stops at September.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Clear order, frame 2 pays, the turn at 7 lands late; 3 and 5 overlap.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean with a strong caption opener; flat lines and thin regional texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Same item as no. 31 with no development since September; familiar staged world; a fresh paper counter.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat slabs at 1.55 to 1, a beige band, the deck's brightest canvas.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low raking key, one fixed offset per card, a dark curb and lawn.
A draped vest, the eyeline up at the column, a cool rim.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stock folders with no thickness or shadow.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tighter crop, pressboard thickness raked by the window key.
Letter-size notice in both hands, close the notch.
